content.title: Appendix B — Strategic Comparison: Airbus
content.content:
SnapLogic is positioned uniquely for emerging competitive edge from A/B test results and build recommendations at every journey point to conversion. AI LLM-infused recommendations to B2C and B2B customers integrating personalized chatbot recommendations based on real-time buying behaviors. The AI infused integrations is a competitive edge we do not see with traditional ETL integration platforms.

**B.1: AI-First Integration: AI-Dare Trust as a Differentiator**

SnapGPT Text-to-Pipeline enables business analysts to build integrations from natural language prompts. This capability does not exist in Informatica IDMC (cloud-only AI), nor in any competitor on-premises ETL/ELT platform. SnapGPT operates entirely on pipeline metadata — never on customer data. For Airbus Helicopters, this capability enables Citizen Integrator workflows that reduce backlog and accelerate delivery without requiring deep integration expertise for every use case. Competitors position AI as roadmap features; SnapLogic ships it today in production.

**B.2: On-Premises Architecture with Modern Foundations**

Informatica PowerCenter is a legacy monolithic platform requiring dedicated VMs and manual capacity management. SnapLogic Ground Plex runs on containerized OpenShift, enabling modern cloud-native deployment patterns (horizontal scaling, stateless architecture, Helm-based configuration) while maintaining genuine on-premises execution. This architectural advantage positions SnapLogic to align with Airbus Helicopters' infrastructure modernization trajectory — containerized platforms are easier to scale, monitor, and operate at enterprise scale. PowerCenter deployments are static; SnapLogic is elastic.

[BOX:blue]
**Informatica IDMC Note:** Informatica's modern IDMC platform is cloud-first with limited on-premises capability. For customers requiring genuine on-premises execution (data sovereignty, ITAR, regulatory compliance), IDMC is not a viable path forward. PowerCenter is end-of-life with declining investment — SnapLogic provides a modern alternative that meets both on-premises requirements and modern architectural patterns.
[/BOX]
